title: Audit the stale demand-to-product, navigation, ATM, labor, and company lineage without importing protected authority or financial effects
reason: PR 190 modifies the monolithic company runtime from a base 737 commits behind current main and mixes useful fail-closed candidate modeling with unbound ATM liquidity and payroll inputs, caller-maintained repayment replay state, hard-coded Company and Life identities, location and labor evidence supplied by the caller, financial policy values lacking current Canon or Human authorization, and external-execution language. Current main has newer demand-first, verified field-service scan, workforce-gap, location-consent, work-order, salary-evidence, wallet-separation, and strategy gates. The only safe bounded task is an evidence-only lineage audit that changes no Runtime, test, UI, Canon, CURRENT, authority, employment, payment, deployment, workflow, or pull-request state.

inventory.security_blocker: PR 190 ATM, payroll, liquidity, repayment, navigation, location, labor, identity, employment, product ownership, and external-execution candidates cannot be transplanted without current repository-bound authority and durable evidence.

blocking_findings: PR 190 is open, Draft, non-mergeable, diverged, and 737 commits behind exact current main.
The stale branch replaces a monolithic company runtime whose current-main blob has independently evolved; direct import would overwrite newer safety and business primitives.
The candidate intentionally rejects caller-labeled VERIFIED demand because no repository-bound demand verifier exists; its product decision is therefore local candidate output only.
ATM advance eligibility relies on caller-provided accrued payroll and ATM liquidity amounts without repository-bound payroll, treasury, liquidity, custody, signer, or settlement evidence.
The 30 percent advance cap, 1 percent fee, fee bounds, prefunded-liquidity rule, and related product economics lack current protected Canon and explicit Human financial authorization.
Repayment replay protection accepts a caller-provided used-repayment-id collection and reports replay_consumed false; it is not a durable authoritative global replay registry.

Navigation and location decisions rely on caller-supplied permission, GPS-session, map-position, land-entry, and birthplace records and do not independently establish consent, revocation, provenance, ownership, or current location authority.
Hard-coded Company, Life, owner, product, listing, route, and K11520 identities do not prove controller, ownership, installation, purchase, deployment, or operating authority.
Human relay labor records contain caller-shaped actor, document, timestamp, duration, and rate-policy references and cannot prove performed work, employment, payable time, review, or compensation.
Status strings such as decisions ready, implemented review candidate, and financial report complete may be mistaken for authoritative completion if separated from their local-only and not-live gates.

Historical exact-head tests demonstrate deterministic candidate behavior and fail-closed assertions only; they do not provide current-main equivalence, financial authority, employment authority, location provenance, settlement readiness, or deployment evidence.
External automation remains orchestration only and cannot become Company Core, appoint reviewers or workers, perform labor, or execute protected side effects.
safe_successor_requirements: Start from exact current main on a non-codex branch and reuse current demand-first, field-service, work-order, location-consent, salary-evidence, wallet-separation, and persistence primitives.

Bind demand, payroll accrual, liquidity, treasury, custody, signer, settlement, location consent, revocation, map position, labor, reviewer, Company, Life, and product ownership claims to authoritative repository-defined evidence and independent verifiers.
Use append-only durable replay state with atomic reserve-before-effect behavior; do not trust caller-provided used identifiers as global replay authority.

Keep financial policy, fees, advance limits, payroll, repayment, settlement, custody, product pricing, and liquidity disabled until exact protected Canon and side-effect-specific Human authorization exist.
Do not create, activate, appoint, employ, pay, review as, or confer ownership on any Worker, Life, controller, signer, operator, company, product, or external agent.

Require separate exact-head adversarial tests for identity substitution, caller-shaped evidence, replay races, stale consent, revocation, insufficient liquidity, wallet separation, and false completion claims before any current-main implementation.
